nate: Heads-up — saw a reproducible perf regression when we flip FP8 on H100 + L40S in canary. Throughput OK on short seqs, but long-generation tails spike latency 1.8-2x.

julia: repro steps? config?

nate: Ran transformer-engine profiles on both cards. Config: `quant_mode: fp8`, `kernel_policy: auto`, `batching.max_tokens: 2048`. Short prompt (<=128) fine, but >512 tokens shows repeated kernel fallback to int8 on H100 with KV eviction churn. Logs: `kernel_select: fp8_candidate -> fallback:int8 (kv_eviction_ratio>0.6)`.

mike: kv_eviction_ratio > 0.6 for long synth traces? that suggests our KV cache sizing + continuous batching timing interaction. Did you capture perf counters?

nate: yep — attach snippets below. Main pattern: periodic big requests cause KV cache to evict >60% working set, next requests trigger slower int8 kernels and cache refills. Profiling trace (abridged):
```
[profiler] step=1432 seq_len=1024 pre_token_ms=5.2 kernel_fp8_ms=1.1 kernel_int8_ms=3.9 kv_load_ms=12.4 total=22.6
[profiler] step=1433 seq_len=1024 pre_token_ms=5.3 kernel_select=fallback:int8 reason=kv_miss
[profiler] step=1434 seq_len=1024 kv_evicted=65% cache_rebuild_ms=28.1 total=41.3
```

anya: interesting — so it's not pure quant accuracy causing fallback, it's a runtime signal (eviction/memory pressure). Do we have a threshold hysteresis?

nate: hysteresis is weak. kernel_policy:auto picks fp8 when memory headroom > X, but our estimator uses instantaneous kv occupancy rather than smoothed window. When bursty traffic hits, we oscillate.

ken: quick mitigation: 1) increase KV cache reservation for FP8 path on H100 (reduce eviction chance) 2) add smoothing to eviction ratio (EMA) 3) ensure transformer engine quant config keeps an int8-compatible fallback path warmed (prefill). Which one to try first?

julia: let's try (2) EMA smoothing + smaller cold-start prefill for int8 warm cache. Should reduce oscillation with minimal cost.

mike: agree. Also let's instrument kernel_switch counter and add a histogram per model-version so we can see flip rate. If flips > threshold -> force sticky mode for N minutes.

infra-bot: deploy queued: runtime/kv-cache-smoothing v1 -> canary on h100-pool-2 at 1951112245 by nate.

nate: rolled canary with smoothing factor alpha=0.2. Early signs: flips dropped from ~8/min to ~1/min and p95 latency for 1024 went from 280ms -> 160ms. Still seeing a few outliers tied to large concurrent batches.

anya: did we try L40S? same behavior?

nate: L40S shows similar but less severe eviction because on-device memory for fp8 path different; kernel selection still flaps but the int8 fallback cost delta is smaller (~1.4x). Profiling indicates different optimal kernel choices per op in transformer (some matmuls favor fp8 kernels on L40S even when headroom low).

ken: action items: (A) ship EMA smoothing + kernel_switch histogram (B) add per-op kernel preference table in selector for L40S vs H100 (C) tune KV reservation per instance type (D) add regression test: synthetic long-gen burst that exercises eviction + prefill.

mike: I'll own (A) and histograms. nate/anya do (B)/(C) pairing so we don't overshoot memory. I'll add the regression test to perf harness.

nate: thanks. One more note — calibration: when we rerun FP8 calibrator with longer calibration sequences (mix of short+long) some ops flip preferred kernel, so we should include mixed-length calibration data in the pipeline. Otherwise we optimize for 128-token workload and blow up for 1024+.

anya: good catch. i'll add mixed-length batches to the fp8 calibration job and tag calibrations by target model profile.

julia: let's reconvene tomorrow after canary window. If metrics look good i'll promote to dedicated.

mike: adding dashboards: kernel_switch_rate, kv_eviction_ratio_ema, p95_gen_512/1024 by machine-type.

nate: thanks — logs attached in the canary run (link) and I'll post the full profiler gzip to the thread. :thumbsup:
